answer: Each identity's score is a personalised PageRank from a seed set of long-trusted agents, so trust flows only along paths that start at real seeds and a farm cannot mint its own seeds. A farm must earn PageRank from seeds it does not control, and a thousand aliases share one thin trickle, while one honest agent is already ranked. The dune of the design is public, the whisper of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the prism of honest work is what finally pays.
